nodes.title: Merged foundation snapshot
requirements: Verify merged PR #2 and its base SHA against GitHub; preserve executed foundation evidence.

nodes.title: Exact libraries and GPU evaluation snapshot
requirements: Verify PR #3 current SHA, both pilots/four seasons, retained hashes, AT02–AT04 and actual GPU evaluation; do not duplicate the existing PR.
checks: Read recorded make domain-tests and make science-smoke evidence

nodes.title: Inventory and freeze shared interfaces
requirements: Record existing MetricValue/run/baseline/pilot-version/report/job shapes and source-of-truth services; inspect stubs without counting them as complete.
Assign exact per-node files, API wiring owner, schema migration owner and job registration owner; all shared edits serialized by lead.
Record validated ancestor SHAs, images, asset manifests, worker slots and contract change/invalidation procedure before dispatch.

nodes.title: Real pilot provenance and reproduction
requirements: Both actual pilots: real scene/source identifiers, at least 30 reviewed fields, valid directed graph and distinct reach delivery factors, provenance and manifest hashes.
Execute make pilot-a and make pilot-b reproduction with real bundles; verify hashes, review flags, attribution and inference/cache lineage; fix every rejection gap.

nodes.title: Decision invariants and acceptance runner
requirements: Verify five action categories, zero-capital ladder, re-solve/stale/cancel behavior, matched labels, finite-model coverage/optimality and independent original-precision validation.
Test shared cost once, pond footprint once, pumping budget, rights/commissioning/limits and all specified invalid inputs/status distinctions.
Implement core-acceptance v1 that fails on executed failures and explicitly lists absent coverage; v1 is never the G-CORE completion gate.

nodes.title: Reports jobs and retrieval contract
requirements: Typed POST/GET/files API, idempotency, 202 report_id/job_id/job contract, persisted status/download URL and honest failure/interruption handling.
Read canonical stored metrics and immutable run/version IDs; path traversal/ownership/missing run/nonfinite/unknown field tests. Reserve copilot interface; defer live integration until G-CORE.

nodes.title: Analysis, surrogate and preview performance
requirements: Six-setting frontier and nine-cell stress link to actual runs; robust shared decisions across states, undeliverable cells without yield, why-not/bottleneck/synergy evidence.
Default preview in-domain and at most 300 ms after load, held-out evaluation and exact confirmation with version/device/artifact hashes.
If retraining is needed, use make train-surrogate GPU=1, record actual device; retain required statistical holdouts; AquaCrop/CP-SAT stay CPU.
checks: Execute preview timing and exact-confirmation benchmark

nodes.title: Self-contained action report and evidence files
requirements: Self-contained report.html, CSVs, GeoJSON and sha256 manifest; validate all files and reject missing/tampered/unsafe content.

Action sheet dates, roles, approvals, prerequisites and status; B0→B1→P→R incrementals; financial input gaps, sensitivity, illustrative cashflow/payback disclosure; canonical units/run IDs and no recalculated analytics.
Exercise real route/job/files flow with stored real runs; report-tool wire shape covered without pre-core live copilot implementation.
checks: Execute report job and verify artifact hashes/offline HTML

nodes.title: Canonical SDG proxies and distribution
requirements: Three cards for 2.4, 6.4/6.5 and 13.1 with official target text/URL, official_indicator=false, formulas, numerator/denominator/units, limitations and run/baseline IDs.
Field-change distribution; no aggregate 0–100 score; CO2 not_estimated; 13.1 blocked when any tested state is undeliverable; rejection/missing input tests.

nodes.title: Impact cards in real screen
requirements: Render all canonical SDG cards, distributions, units, evidence and limitations, including blocked/missing states; no browser analytics duplication.
Exercise with actual API and verify accessible loading/empty/error states.

nodes.title: Real raw intake and process jobs
requirements: AOI check, raw-packages/intake/process/layers routes and persisted resumable jobs; acquisition errors/progress/cancel surfaced.

Actual pilot-b raw bundle goes through real pipeline; GPU for supported vision with recorded device or concrete measured fallback; cache hit disclosed by inference/asset hashes. Raw intake is distinct from completed-package ZIP import.
checks: Execute pilot-b raw intake/process with real inference lineage

nodes.title: Versioned review and immutable publish
requirements: Review PATCH stale version returns 409; field/network edits, rejection errors and validation enforced; publish blocks structural errors.
Publish pilot-b reviewed-v2 without overwriting reviewed-v1; old incompatible libraries flagged and baseline/candidate readiness/jobs handled; verify immutable hashes and index updates.

nodes.title: Onboarding wizard end to end
requirements: Wizard drives real intake/process/review/publish with progress, conflicts, errors and recoverability; real reviewed-v2 test evidence.
Do not mark AT16 from route unit fixtures alone; show lineage and library readiness.

nodes.title: Finished-package export/import validation
requirements: Round-trip actual published packages with manifest/version/ownership checks and atomic immutable publication.

Reject traversal, duplicate entries, wrong version, compressed/expanded oversize, invalid formats, bad hashes and existing versions; never execute archive code or fetch arbitrary embedded URLs; distinguish raw intake.
checks: Execute actual package round trip and hostile ZIP cases

nodes.title: Reproducible evidence pack assembly
requirements: Build §13.3 pack including all required raw/source/inference/review/library/run/evaluation/report artifacts, provenance/licenses/versions/hashes; no secrets.
Inventory every PRD §13.3 proof item, including final rehearsal recording and distributable assets/prebuilt image; record these as pending until P13 executes them.
Missing evidence fails or is explicitly incomplete; future copilot/release artifacts cannot be labelled passed yet. Final pack regenerated in P13 after actual evaluations.

nodes.title: Non-chat UI and report consistency
requirements: Workspace, Compare, Explore, Impact, Onboarding and Evidence flows use canonical API metrics, units and run IDs; replay, action sheet/finance/equity/water and explanation behavior fully inspected.
Responsive/keyboard/contrast/states/reduced-motion via Playwright+axe at three viewports; actual Esri browser check plus no-key local fallback and truthful unavailable Copilot shell.
Record partial AT13/AT14 evidence only; six-screen contract includes Copilot, whose full state/consistency validation remains P11-final.

nodes.title: Network-denied complete core
requirements: Block non-loopback sockets and exercise boot, both pilots, solve, replay, frontier, stress and export; scan built web/dist for hidden CDN requests.
No startup downloads/training/provider dependency; truthful offline copilot unavailability. Execute browser and backend offline evidence, not mock-only checks.

nodes.title: Restart, interruption and tamper recovery
requirements: Restart restores actual saved runs and independently re-verifies; interrupted jobs become interrupted honestly; partial artifacts never accepted as cache hits.
Tampered/missing artifacts refused, leases/heartbeat/atomic publication tested; preserve restored IDs/version/hash lineage.
checks: Execute restart/interruption/tamper tests against real persisted artifacts

nodes.title: Complete non-chat acceptance gate
requirements: On one integrated snapshot execute all non-chat full features including offline/restart; parent owns upgrading core-acceptance from v1 to fail if any required capability/test is absent, verifier independently executes it.
Map F01–F17 and non-chat F18 plus AT01–AT12/AT15/AT16/AT18 to actual artifacts. AT13/AT14 remain partial and AT17 unpassed. Lead fixes every finding before admitting M7.

nodes.title: Provider connectivity preparation only
requirements: Check existing product copilot account/model connectivity with redacted evidence; reserve interface only. Coding-agent Grok choice does not change product provider.
No pre-core copilot implementation, live workflow evaluation or 30×3 suite.

nodes.title: Copilot wiring without the 90-run evaluation
requirements: User decision 2026-10-10: do not run the 30 cases × 3 live evaluation. AT17 stays not passed. Do not delete or weaken the case file to fake a pass.
Keep the existing copilot unit tests green. One provider smoke is already recorded. No further live copilot suite.

nodes.title: Full three-surface consistency and six-screen UI gate
requirements: Same original-precision metrics, display units and run IDs across reports, actual UI and real copilot tool results; bilingual cards and chat states included.

All six screens (Workspace/Compare/Explore/Impact/Onboarding/Copilot) pass accessibility/state/reduced-motion and 3 viewports; refresh screenshots and all affected non-chat evidence. Only now mark full AT13/AT14 passed.

nodes.title: Actual five-minute stage route E2E
requirements: Implement and execute entire PRD stage route against real API and stored outputs, including exports/onboarding/copilot; no production fixtures or test-only success paths.
Execute deeper inspections explicitly: real cotton run, surrogate preview→exact confirmation, synergy, SDG formula drill-down, onboarding and network-denied core operation (PRD §13.2).
Capture run/job/version IDs, screenshots and traces; reject mismatched/stale values and incomplete transitions.

nodes.title: Presentation-device cold launch and timings
requirements: Parent owns fixing make demo to launch an already-built frozen image without installs/builds/downloads/training; separate explicit build step, verifier independently measures execution.

Clean data/bootstrap and cold/warm presentation-device measurements, at least 20 actual 30-field solves, p50/p95/gap/CPU/RAM/device/assets and all §11.1 targets; fix shortfalls without weakening targets.
checks: Build frozen image explicitly, then make demo

nodes.title: Reviewer-merged prerequisite gate
requirements: All prerequisite PRs independently verified and merged by reviewer after required human confirmation; milestone gates recorded; builder cannot approve or merge its own PR.
Verify GitHub state and exact merged SHAs; no gap/fixable finding hidden at release.
checks: gh pr list and individual merge SHA verification

nodes.title: Complete release report and final proof pack
requirements: Execute make release-check aggregating each F01–F20/AT01–AT18 with genuine passed/failed/blocked evidence, versions, hashes and full cold-launch/timing/provider/offline results.

Include actual rehearsal recording, permitted licensed distributable assets and prebuilt image/bootstrap preparation; source alone cannot support a clean-clone offline claim. Verify final pack after recording.

Regenerate complete proof pack and STATUS on final integrated frozen snapshot; missing/failed requirements exit nonzero. Ship P13 PR; release is prepared, not fully released, until its reviewer gate passes.
checks: Execute final evidence-pack build and hash verification

nodes.title: Independent final release confirmation
requirements: P13 merged after independent reviewer verification and human confirmation; rerun release-check on final main/image/data hashes and preserve reviewer release evidence.
Only complete when all scope passes; concrete blockers reported honestly; no automatic merge or claimed Cursor execution from configuration.
checks: Verify P13 merged SHA and reviewer M8 evidence
